question: ​Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"this year."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The use of **"this year"** is appropriate in the context of the sentence, which discusses a specific year that is currently ongoing.
 
• **"Those years" and "that year"** refer to periods of time in the past, which are not relevant to the sentence.
 
• **"The year"** is too vague and does not provide enough information about which year is being referred to.
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 4.
